verdict.rationale: Ente Auth markets and documents bulk import from many 2FA apps, including 2FAS, Aegis, andOTP, Bitwarden, Google Authenticator (multi-QR in one session), LastPass, Proton, Raivo and OTP Auth, plus plaintext and encrypted files. A community user confirms the Aegis export-and-import switch was easy. missing for 10: native import from Authy (it needs an external conversion to Ente's plaintext format), and bulk import from Microsoft Authenticator (the docs only describe re-scanning each QR code by hand).

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: Ente Auth natively supports imports from many 2FA providers.
Import multi-QR Google Authenticator exports in a single session.
Added support for importing backups from OTP Auth
This switch (export and import) was very easy.
